purpose: Complete TimesNet and Mamba-2 comparisons for the frozen stride-24 relation-auxiliary Electricity/Traffic H96 screen.
research_question: Does the stride-24 AutoCon MambaTSv3 candidate remain competitive with TimesNet and Mamba-2 under the same seeds and budget?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory extension. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This only completes a high-dimensional fixed-shape validation matrix. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal speed, independent AutoCon causality, or cross-domain generalization.

required_before_launch: retain candidate seeds and current budget

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The pre-existing sparse candidate's architecture and seeds are fixed; this extension freezes only TimesNet/Mamba2 under the same split, budget, normalization, and seeds.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both baselines share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization with the sparse candidate.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: TimesNet and Mamba2 receive no AutoCon, representation fusion, ACF memory, or candidate-only setting.

phases.name: strong_baselines_stride24_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-seed TimesNet and Mamba2 high-dimensional baselines.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Use a strict reader to combine only source-identical candidate and baseline artifacts. Forward resources are measured separately.

stopping_rules: Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
Do not promote the sparse candidate if it is more than 2% worse than either strong baseline on either dataset.
Do not infer AutoCon causality from candidate-versus-baseline differences.
prelaunch_gates: retain candidate seeds and fixed budget
